video.title: AI欧腐《与仇人成婚/Married to My Enemy》
video.desc:
简介太长 记得往下拉
When his mother prepares to marry Constantine Vey, the powerful man responsible for his father's death, Cashel Duvall proposes a marriage of his own: to Constantine's son, Dorian. The man he once rescued is now his prospective stepbrother, and their union becomes a weapon against the patriarch who controls both families. But Dorian blames Cashel for his mother's breakdown, turning their alliance into a volatile mix of suspicion, cruelty, and desire. As Cashel uncovers an art forgery operation and seeks evidence of past crimes, allies prove unreliable and Constantine uses their mothers' lives to keep the men under his control. What begins as a marriage for revenge grows into love, yet Dorian's jealousy and need for control threaten to repeat the harm they are trying to escape. To bring Constantine down, they must confront the secrets behind their parents' suffering and decide whether they can build a bond that offers freedom instead of another cage.
当母亲准备和 Constantine Vey——那个害死父亲的权势之人——结婚时，Cashel Duvall 提出了一桩属于自己的婚事：和 Constantine 的儿子 Dorian 结婚。他曾经救过的那个人，如今成了他未来的继兄，而这段婚姻，也成了对抗那位掌控两个家族的家主的武器。
然而 Dorian 把母亲的精神崩溃归咎于 Cashel，两人的同盟就此变成猜忌、残忍与欲望交织的危险混合物。随着 Cashel 揭开一桩艺术品造假的黑幕、追查旧日罪行的证据，盟友一个个靠不住，而 Constantine 则以两人母亲的性命为筹码，牢牢控制着他们。
一场为复仇而起的婚姻，渐渐长成了爱。可 Dorian 的嫉妒与控制欲，却可能让他们重蹈正在逃离的那种伤害。要扳倒 Constantine，两人必须直面父母苦难背后的秘密，并做出抉择：他们能否建立一段带来自由、而非另一座牢笼的关系。
